meaning.zh:
“千钧一发” 或 “死里逃生”。

这个短语源于剃须（shaving）时刀刃贴近皮肤的危险感，比喻处于非常危险的境况或险些遭遇不测。在现代英语中，它经常被用来描述一个人刚刚避免了一场事故或险情，意味着事情非常接近灾难，但最终逃脱了。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from the act of shaving where a razor blade is very close to the skin, implying a sense of danger. It is used metaphorically to describe a situation where someone narrowly avoids an accident or disaster, indicating that the situation was very close to being harmful but was ultimately escaped.

lines.en: He had a *close shave* when his car skidded on the ice.
lines.zh: 他的车在冰上打滑，简直是在鬼门关前走了一遭。

lines.en: That was a *close shave*; I almost broke my leg!
lines.zh: 刚才真是千钧一发，我差点摔断腿！

lines.en: The hikers had a *close shave* with the falling rocks.
lines.zh: 这些徒步旅行者差一点被落石砸中，真是死里逃生。
